bugs.description: The transfer debits the source before checking whether the destination is locked, so the failure path leaves balances partially mutated.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: The source has sufficient funds and the destination account ID starts with locked-.
bugs.observableImpact: The transfer throws, but the source balance remains reduced and total ledger value is no longer conserved.
bugs.provenance: Seeded from a base implementation that performed all validation before either balance mutation. Confirmed by curator-only executable proof.
